jobs.name: validate
jobs.$mirrors: validate.yml `validate`, steps run from the workflow file; the shellcheck apt install is dropped (installed locally)

jobs.name: config-drift
jobs.$mirrors: validate.yml `config-drift`, steps run from the workflow file

jobs.name: commitlint
jobs.$mirrors: validate.yml `commitlint`, the same pattern over origin/main..HEAD
commands: bash -c 'pattern="^(feat|fix|chore|docs|refactor|test|perf|style|ci|build|revert)(\([a-z0-9 ./-]+\))?!?: .+"; fail=0; while read -r sha; do s=$(git log -1 --format=%s "$sha"); echo "$s" | grep -Eq "$pattern" || { echo "non-conventional: $s"; fail=1; }; done < <(git rev-list --no-merges origin/main..HEAD); exit $fail'

jobs.name: mcp-github
jobs.$mirrors: validate.yml `mcp-github` (always run: the path filter only saves runner minutes)

jobs.name: ci-success
jobs.localReason: The CI Success aggregate only reads the other jobs' results; the replica's table and verdict.json are that aggregate here. Verified on Actions by the ci-on-main owed verdict.
